description.p: AshyWall gathers the wallpapers installed on the system, the images in folders you choose and the ones you download, and applies them to the GNOME desktop.

ul.li: Filters by orientation and resolution (Full HD, QHD, 4K and 8K)
Full-screen view as the desktop shows it, the whole image, or at actual size
Wallpapers from BigLinux, Wallhaven, the Bing image of the day and the Wikimedia Commons picture of the day, with author and license when the source gives them
Favorites and collections that mix local and online wallpapers
Automatic change through GNOME's own slideshow, without a background process
Optional RSS and Atom reading list with topics, cached search and read state; full articles open in the default browser

description.p: Optional RSS and Atom reading with native GNOME navigation, topic filters and offline caching. Faster library browsing, stricter HTTPS redirects and concurrent request limits.
First release: local library, previews and full-screen view, favorites and collections, automatic change, and wallpapers from BigLinux, Wallhaven, Bing and Wikimedia Commons.
